MagePlan:
Hi everyone, and thanks for trying MagePlan!

I build MagePlan while I level on WoW Forever, and it gets updates almost every day. Your feedback decides what comes next.

New lately:
- Your own talent build: paste a link from Wowhead's WoW Forever talent calculator or wow-forever-forge.com with "Import talents" in the settings (or /mp import). Right-click "Next talent" (or /mp skip) to skip a talent.
- Dungeon guide for Alliance and Horde, with Ragefire Chasm and the nine new WoW Forever dungeons.
- Profession routes made for WoW Forever, with trainers and vendors for your faction.
- Bag check window: sell or disenchant from one window when you're at a vendor.
- Party marks: a small button that marks your party with one click.

I'd love to hear about:
- Features you want. What would make leveling your mage easier?
- Is the Shatter indicator showing at the right moments, and is it in a good spot on your screen?
- Which mage chores would you like help with? Portals, food and water for the group, mana gems, anything else?
- The talent plans. Do you level with a different build? You can import it now, and I'd still like to hear which talents and why.
- Bugs. Anything that looks wrong, shows the wrong thing or throws an error.

When you report a bug, please include:
- The addon version (top left of the settings window)
- Your spec and level
- What you did and what happened
- The full Lua error if you got one (BugSack makes it easy to copy)

The code is open source (GPL-3.0) on GitHub, and you're welcome to open issues there too: https://github.com/zodac-75/CorePlan/issues

Happy leveling!
zodac
